2 loan. ₹1 lakh extra. Pehle kaun sa chukayein? 🤔

Credit card: kai issuers ~3.75%/mahina = ~45%/saal
Personal loan: 12%/saal (sirf example)

₹1 lakh card pe = ~₹45,000 interest bacha
₹1 lakh loan pe = ~₹12,000
Farak: ~₹33,000 HAR SAAL

Avalanche method: sabse mehenga loan pehle. Baaki ki minimum EMI time pe.

Save karo, EMI bharte waqt kaam aayega. Aapka sabse mehenga loan kaun sa hai? 👇
